checks.name: Route-level sanity of screens.json proposedRoute for Next.js App Router
checks.detail: Routes are proposals (START-HERE known exception 5). All designed workspace-surface IDs start with their navigation.json baseRoute (/student, /faculty, /institute, /vendor, /reviewer, /content-manager, /admin) except FA-22 (an action). Of 123 designed proposedRoute values: 91 are literal paths, 13 are paths with query parameters (?tab= / ?step=), and 19 are not literal routes (annotations, multi-route " · " values, ellipses, a "|" enumeration, "→" prefixes, a file name). 14 paths are shared by more than one ID (states/tabs on one URL). One abbreviated value (SA-15 "/courses/[courseId]"), read literally, would collide with public PU-05 /courses/[courseCode] and fail the Next.js build ("different slug names for the same dynamic path"). IA-14 "/new" contradicts its board: B2-08 f1 draws "Create group (DL-3)" as a dialog on the Groups list, not a page. The Student hub "Assessment" tab is drawn (B4-11 f7-f9 "Hub · Assessment tab") but has no ID and no route. Tabs are modelled inconsistently (path segments vs ?tab=), and 18 intermediate paths implied by child routes have no page. See routeIssues.

routeIssues.issue: /student/experiments/[experimentId]/simulation/web (static) and .../simulation/[format] (dynamic) are siblings. Next.js matches static "web" first, so [format] also accepts "web" and any other string unless restricted. Format codes are upper-case on boards (WEB · AR · VR · MR) but the literal segment is lower-case.
routeIssues.suggestion: Keep static web/ and restrict [format] to ar|vr|mr (generateStaticParams + dynamicParams=false, or notFound() otherwise). Or use one [format] route with a WEB branch. Use lower-case slugs everywhere (ST-16 feedback/[format] includes web).

routeIssues.issue: Malformed value "/admin/roles?tab=vendors|reviewers|content-managers" ("|" enumerates three alternatives). B7-08 tab order: Vendors · Reviewers · Content Managers; the 1440 frame opens on the Reviewers tab (sample).
routeIssues.suggestion: /admin/roles?tab=vendors (default) | ?tab=reviewers | ?tab=content-managers, or path tabs /admin/roles/vendors etc. Holder detail SA-17 /admin/roles/[holderId] then needs ids that cannot equal a tab slug.

routeIssues.issue: Two routes in one value, the second abbreviated: "/admin/structure/areas/[areaId] · /courses/[courseId]". Read literally, /courses/[courseId] collides with public PU-05 /courses/[courseCode] and Next.js refuses different slug names for the same dynamic path (build error).
routeIssues.suggestion: Expand to /admin/structure/areas/[areaId] and /admin/structure/courses/[courseId]. /admin/structure/areas and /admin/structure/courses have no index page: redirect to /admin/structure.

routeIssues.issue: Value "/institute/people/groups/[groupId] · /new": two routes, the second abbreviated. Board conflict: B2-08 f0 note "Create group opens DL-3; empty and duplicate names are refused in words", and f1 "Create group (DL-3)" (hasDialog) draws creation as a dialog on the Groups list, not a /new page (board wins).
routeIssues.suggestion: Route only /institute/people/groups/[groupId]. Create group is a DL-3 dialog on /institute/people?tab=groups. Do not build /groups/new.

routeIssues.issue: Two routes in one value: "/faculty/question-bank/new · /faculty/question-bank/[questionId]". Static siblings new, draft (FA-16) and import (FA-17) sit beside [questionId].
routeIssues.suggestion: Two route files: question-bank/new/page.tsx and question-bank/[questionId]/page.tsx. Question ids (sample Q-0101) must never equal new/draft/import.

routeIssues.issue: CM-08 holds two routes in one value (list and detail). CM-06/CM-07 values begin with "→" plus an annotation: they are entry actions that open a correction (UPD) draft at /content-manager/updates/[updateId], so three IDs share one detail route. No creation route exists, and B6-08 shows a third entry control, "Start a correction".
routeIssues.suggestion: /content-manager/updates (CM-08 list) and /content-manager/updates/[updateId] (draft/detail). Entry controls on CM-05 call a mock service that creates the UPD draft (pre-filled per M-1) and then router.push to its detail. If an update is already in progress, B6-08 f1/f2 show "Open update" instead.

routeIssues.issue: Ellipsis step values: "/faculty/assessments/new?step=1…4" (B4-04 draws 4 steps + Created / Saved-as-draft results) and "/institute/student-access/give?step=1…" (B2-05 draws 3 steps + "Access given"). Step modelling differs elsewhere: VE-03..06 use named steps (?step=course|formats|preview|submit) across two paths (/new, then /[submissionId]/edit after the first save, OD-B5-07); PU-08 → PU-09 uses a path (/request-access/sent).
routeIssues.suggestion: Choose one convention (e.g. named ?step= slugs) and keep the drawn step order. FA-07 ?step=1..4; IA-05 ?step=1..3. The result states (Created, Access given) are states of the same flow, not routes. B4-04 f6 "Created · ASMT-0009" and f7 "Saved as draft" ("Name and rules only: not ready, not visible to students") both offer "Open assessment", which goes to /faculty/assessments/[assessmentId].

routeIssues.issue: States, menus, actions and a file given as "routes": "/requests/[requestId] (Access active state)", "/ (#for-institutions section)", "not-found.tsx", "/sign-in (links only — flows OPEN)", "(top bar) account menu", "(shell) paused / inactive banner", ".../feedback/[format] (sent state)", "/student/experiments/[experimentId] (not-available state)", "/reviewer/submissions/[submissionId] (decided, read-only)", "(action) Export CSV on FA-20 / FA-12".
routeIssues.suggestion: Do not create routes for these. Render them as states of the parent route driven by the shared state, plus app/not-found.tsx (PU-15), the shell account menu (XS-05) and the shell banner (XS-08). Activation and forgot-password links on /sign-in go nowhere (flows OPEN, T-10/T-11).

routeIssues.issue: Tabs are modelled two ways. Path segments: Student hub (resources/simulation/progress), Faculty assessment tabs, SA Content (updates/all), SA Operations (device-transfers/support/access-ending). Query ?tab=: My courses (ST-04, FA-04), IA People (students/faculty/groups/faculty-courses), IA Content access course-codes, IA Requests devices, Vendor record history, SA Platform roles. Children of ?tab= parents use path segments (/institute/people/students/[studentId], /institute/requests/devices/[transferId]), so a tab and its children do not share a prefix.
routeIssues.suggestion: Pick one convention per parent and document it. Keep the proposals where the owner has not ruled — URLs are the implementer's choice (START-HERE exception 5) — but make sure each tab is linkable and keyboard-operable and that browser back works.

routeIssues.issue: 18 intermediate paths implied by child routes have no screen: /admin/content, /admin/content/records, /admin/operations, /admin/structure/areas, /content-manager/decisions, /content-manager/published, /courses, /faculty/experiments, /institute/content-access/plans, /institute/people/faculty, /institute/people/groups, /institute/people/students, /institute/requests/devices, /requests, /reviewer/submissions, /reviewer/updates, /student/experiments, /student/experiments/[experimentId]/feedback. /admin/content and /admin/operations are sidebar destinations ("Content", "Operations") with no own route.
routeIssues.suggestion: Redirect /admin/content → /admin/content/updates and /admin/operations → /admin/operations/device-transfers (first tab on boards 05/06 and B8-01). Redirect each list-less intermediate to its list (e.g. /institute/people/students → /institute/people?tab=students) or return notFound(). Do not invent new pages.

routeIssues.issue: The hub "Assessment" tab is drawn (B4-11 f7-f9: to do / none yet / waiting for marking; the B2-12/B3-01 tab bar is Overview · Resources · Simulation · Assessment · Progress) but has no ID and no route. Its siblings have path routes (/resources, /simulation, /progress).
routeIssues.suggestion: Add /student/experiments/[experimentId]/assessment as the hub tab (the drawn hub-tab frames); its "Open assessment" goes to ST-12 /student/assessments/[assessmentId]. Report it to the owner as a register gap, not a new screen.

routeIssues.issue: Root dynamic segment /[workspace]/not-allowed and /[workspace]/help is a sibling of 16 static top-level segments (admin, areas, content-manager, courses, experiments, faculty, institute, requests, request-access, reviewer, selection, sign-in, signed-out, student, vendor, ...). It would match nonsense like /areas/help or /requests/help unless constrained. The workspace slugs (student, faculty, institute, vendor, reviewer, content-manager, admin) are the navigation.json baseRoutes.
routeIssues.suggestion: Implement help/ and not-allowed/ inside each workspace route group (one shared component), or constrain [workspace] to the 7 slugs (generateStaticParams + dynamicParams=false). Public has no Help destination (XS-07 is "Sidebar Help in all seven workspaces").

routeIssues.issue: Course param naming differs: public [courseCode] vs [courseId] elsewhere. The platform code contains a space ("ME ZG523", B8-03 Course codes) and may be blank (T-17 "public: platform code (blank allowed)"), so a course without a code has no public URL. Institutions keep their own codes (MEC-523) shown to Students (T-17).
routeIssues.suggestion: Key every course route by a stable course id (or slug) and show the platform / institution code as data. Same param name everywhere.

routeIssues.issue: Experiment identity changes along the pipeline: Vendor /vendor/experiments/[submissionId] (SUB id, given on first save — OD-B5-07); Reviewer and CM decisions by [submissionId]; CM published by [experimentId]; SA content records by [recordId] (SUB or EXP); public, Student and Faculty by [experimentId]. entities.json: SUB "becomes EXP on publication". The 2 Composite Wall records stay separate (OD-B5-09).
routeIssues.suggestion: In the mock services, define the SUB → EXP link explicitly and type recordId as a union. Never derive access from publication (binding constraints 3, 9).

routeIssues.issue: "Student detail (per experiment)" is routed /faculty/students/[studentId] without experiment context. FA-20 is per experiment (B4-10 f0 heading "Shell-and-Tube Heat Exchanger"); the old prototype route was /student/:s/:e.
routeIssues.suggestion: Carry the experiment, e.g. /faculty/students/[studentId]?experiment=[experimentId]. Flag this to the owner rather than choosing silently.

routeIssues.issue: One route, /institute/people/add, covers two drawn forms: B2-07 f0 "IA-10 Add student" and f3 "IA-10 Add faculty member".
routeIssues.suggestion: Use a discriminator (/institute/people/add?type=student|faculty) or two sub-paths. Entry comes from the Students / Faculty tabs.

routeIssues.issue: The public status route /requests/[requestId] uses the request reference as the URL key, but B1-07 says "Reference REQ-0042 identifies the request; it is never presented as a key to the request’s details" and B8-03 says "request reference is not a key". T-01 says "Reference-number link to the status page". PU-10 navigation: "link from confirmation / e-mail: OPEN".
routeIssues.suggestion: In the mock, key the status URL by an opaque token (or a session-scoped link from the confirmation) and show REQ-0042 only as display text. List this tension for the owner.

routeIssues.issue: Static/dynamic sibling collisions to guard: /faculty/assessments/new vs [assessmentId]; /faculty/question-bank/{new,draft,import} vs [questionId]; /vendor/experiments/new vs [submissionId].
routeIssues.suggestion: Next.js prefers static segments. Make sure mock ids (ASMT-0009, Q-0101, SUB-0077 format) can never equal a reserved word.

routeIssues.issue: Sidebar active state cannot use URL prefixes. Board 05 places the Experiment hub and Simulation under "My courses" (ST-F3/ST-F4), but their URLs live under /student/experiments, not /student/courses. Likewise FA-05 /faculty/experiments under "My courses" (/faculty/courses); RV-03/RV-04 under "Review queue" (/reviewer/queue); CM-03 under "Ready to publish" (/content-manager/ready); CM-05 under "Content library" (/content-manager/library).
routeIssues.suggestion: Keep an explicit route → sidebar-item map, derived from screens.json "navigation" and the board 05 families.

routeIssues.issue: 14 paths serve more than one ID: / (PU-01, PU-14, plus annotations for XS-08 and FA-22); /requests/[requestId] (PU-10, PU-13); /sign-in (XS-01, XS-04); /student/courses (ST-02, ST-04 tab); /student/experiments/[experimentId] (ST-05, ST-19); .../feedback/[format] (ST-16, ST-17); /faculty/courses (FA-02, FA-04 tab); /institute/people (IA-06, IA-08, IA-13, IA-15 tabs); /institute/content-access (IA-02, IA-16 tab); /institute/requests (IA-17, IA-18 tab); /vendor/experiments/[submissionId] (VE-07, VE-13 tab); /vendor/experiments/[submissionId]/edit (VE-04, VE-05, VE-06, VE-09); /reviewer/submissions/[submissionId] (RV-03, RV-06); /content-manager/updates/[updateId] (CM-06, CM-07, CM-08).

notes: Every check was run read-only on the checksum-verified extraction. Nothing was executed from the handoff folder (support.js was only hashed).

verdict: The frozen v46 package is internally consistent at the integrity and index level. 178/178 manifest and SHA-256 entries match, and files.json md5/size match on 165/165 entries. The v45 -> v46 delta (19 added, 97 changed, 50 unchanged, 0 removed) matches FREEZE-RECORD and B8-02. screens.json, navigation.json, flows.json, open-decisions.json and tokens.json/css equal their source boards (B8-01, 05/06, B8-04, B8-08, B8-07, xr-foundation.css :root) with 0 field differences. The headline counts (147/123/24, 27 steps, 15 records, 10 rules, 79 = 55+12+7+1+4, 35 = 28+7, 65 tokens, 0 blockers, 111/123 frame-named) all reproduce. The gaps sit between the index and the drawn frames, and in the routes. (1) entities.json gives one status vocabulary per record, but boards use role-relative labels and extra sub-states (REQ Submitted / Payment failed, SACC No access yet / Waiting for a licence, CM return and re-check on SUB, ROLE No scope). "Scope active" is drawn nowhere. RUN "ownerWriter: Student" must not be read as the Student setting Completed. (2) The register omits some drawn frames: the B1-02 explorer and the Student hub Assessment tab on B4-11 have no ID or route. (3) 19 proposedRoute values are not literal routes. SA-15 read literally breaks the Next.js build, IA-14 "/new" contradicts its dialog board, tab conventions are mixed, and 18 intermediate paths need redirects. (4) Small documentation mismatches: the START-HERE path note, the missing link-crawl evidence file, and "three" CSV templates where the markup has two. None of these blocks a mock-service frontend. They should be logged as handoff defects (board wins) and resolved in the route map and state model before building.
